description: Implement automatic upload of seed employees to Firestore on first login, and add validation to detect failed syncs. This ensures Firestore /employees collection is populated so subsequent reads return data. Also adds error detection: if local DB has employees but Firestore fetch returns zero, return failure (not silent success) to alert user/UI of the sync problem.
steps: Modify WorkCoreRepository.syncEmployeesFromFirebase() (around line 1386) to add authentication check at start: verify firebaseDataSource.currentUser != null, else fail with clear error

In syncEmployeesFromFirebase(), after fetchEmployees() succeeds, add logic to detect first sync: if local DB has employees but fetchResult returns empty list, call firebaseDataSource.uploadAllEmployeesToFirestore(allLocalEmployees) to upload seed data
Add SharedPreferences flag to track if upload already happened, preventing duplicate uploads on subsequent logins (use key 'employees_uploaded_to_firebase')

Modify the empty check: if employees.isEmpty(), check if local DB is also empty. If local has data but cloud is empty, return Result.failure() (not success). Log clear error message about possible security rule issue.
Verify existing uploadAllEmployeesToFirestore() method in FirebaseDataSource.kt (line ~750+) works correctly: logs batch progress, catches individual errors, returns upload count

Add comprehensive logging at each step: 'Firebase Auth not initialized', 'First sync detected: uploading...', 'Uploaded X employees to Firestore', 'Empty fetch detected but local has Y employees: possible security rule issue'
acceptance_criteria: First login after app install automatically uploads local seed employees to Firestore (logged as 'First sync detected')
Upload only happens once (tracked by SharedPreferences flag)
If Firestore fetch returns zero but local DB has employees, syncEmployeesFromFirebase() returns Result.failure() (not success)
Logs clearly distinguish between: (1) first sync, (2) empty cloud during first sync, (3) normal sync, (4) sync blocked by auth or security rules
Firebase Auth check prevents null pointer exceptions
verification: Build and install fresh app: ./gradlew installDebug
Login as admin, check logcat for 'First sync detected: uploading local employees to Firestore...'
Check logcat for 'Successfully uploaded 73 employees to Firestore' (or count from SeedData)
Open Firebase Console Firestore > employees collection, verify documents are present
Login again as same user, verify logcat does NOT show second upload (SharedPreferences flag prevents it)
Clear SharedPreferences flag manually, login again, verify upload happens again (proves flag works)
Temporarily disable FEAT-001 (revert rules), login as admin, verify sync fails with 'Possible security rule issue' error message (not silent success)
Verify other login flows (SS employee, AO employee) also trigger sync and fetch employees successfully
findings: FirebaseDataSource.uploadAllEmployeesToFirestore() already implemented but never called. SeedData has 73 real employees that should be available immediately. Current syncEmployeesFromFirebase() logs empty fetch as warning but returns success, preventing error detection. Solution: Call upload on first sync, add validation to detect sync failures.
